justifications.durability: every commit is real, reachable, and additive-only against the plan/evidence docs (git show --stat confirms 55 insertions/0 deletions on the landing commit), the report and dozens of raw job logs are committed under the figure directory rather than left in a run-only scratch, and the node explicitly restored the plan's version/modified meta lines to base rather than leaving edit_plan's side effects in the diff.
justifications.evidence: I independently re-verified an extensive set of this report's most specific, most checkable claims against the raw committed logs and every one matched exactly: the full Python traceback chain (reduced_newton.py:428/1179/1374/1939, compilation_cache.py:352 vs compiler.py:350 as the two arms' differing frame), the EXIT=134 marker, the peak RSS figures recomputed from the memory.txt vmhwm column (8.63 GiB and 8.27 GiB, matching to the hundredth), the map-count-at-death values (62,814 and 65,077/65,078), the bisect job's abort landing in test 21 with 4 failed/17 passed on the clear-caches arm, the 'test 20 alone PASSED, EXIT=0' bisect result, and the plan doc's very specific claim that clearing caches leaves exactly tests 1, 5, 18 and 19 failing (independently derived from the clear-caches log's percentage markers against 21 collected tests and it worked out exactly). Nothing checked disagreed.
justifications.fit: no plan/stage/sprint label appears in any commit, filename, or landed section id; the negative_control_log field is correctly encoded as bare 'none' with an explanatory note (unlike a defect pattern seen elsewhere this session where a reserved-but-nonexistent path was used instead), and the two arms that discriminate the mechanism (persistent-cache-off still aborts; clear-caches removes the abort with the same four pre-existing failures) are exactly the kind of falsifiable A/B a root-cause claim needs.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal (attribute the SIGABRT to a specific mechanism) is met with a causal chain that is both named and demonstrated to be manipulable: the abort is shown to be LLVM's RuntimeDyldELF running out of mmap slots at the kernel's vm.max_map_count ceiling, shown to not depend on the persistent compile cache, and shown to disappear when jax.clear_caches()+gc.collect() are added between tests with zero new failures introduced — a genuine mechanism demonstration, not a correlation. The report is honest about incompleteness (middle-deletion bisection was not run; the smallest ordered subset is 1-20, not a minimal set) rather than overclaiming precision it does not have.
justifications.scope_discipline: the node's own worktree carries two modified-but-uncommitted files (gs-absolute-accuracy figure PNG/SVG) from an unrelated, pre-existing test bug it discovered in passing, and it explicitly disclosed this in follow_ons and left them unstaged rather than either committing out-of-scope changes or silently discarding evidence of a real bug it found; the plan/evidence edits are strictly additive and the meta-line side effects of edit_plan were manually reverted.
